record.text:
Projectyle for the Spectrum Next? Why not!

Codex Astra plus the Claude Code disassemblies of the ST and Amiga versions I made previously created this in a day. Gameplay is mostly complete. Hit me up in the comments for technical details.

#GameDevelopment #RetroGaming #GenerativeAI #SpectrumNext

For those interested, this was a 120-word prompt, ~95 messages, and two days of iteration: Projectyle on the Spectrum Next, built with Codex from my ST/Amiga disassemblies. First playtest after ~3 hours, then physics, AI, parallax, and animation fixes. Plenty of testing still ahead!

record.text: Things you learn in an elevator: In Switzerland, it is illegal to own a single guinea pig because these animals need social interaction.

images.alt: An elevator screen with a black frame displays trivia in French about guinea pig ownership. The blue screen shows a clock in the top-left corner set to 13:52 and a date of 03/10/2026. Next to this is French text that reads "En Suisse, il est illégal de posséder un seul cochon d'Inde car ces animaux ont besoin d'interaction sociale." (which translates to: "In Switzerland, it is illegal to own a single guinea pig because these animals need social interaction."). Below the time is a large blue panel with white text, "RC," which means "Rez-de-Chaussée" or ground floor, with a downward-pointing arrow and a small circle with a line through it. An illustration below the French text depicts three reddish-brown, white, and black guinea pigs grouped together over a bowl against an orange background, with a dark branch with leaves on the right.
